arguments.question: Across ANET, QQQ, MU, META and NVDA, assess material 21/63-session geopolitical and policy transmission channels using available primary policy sources: semiconductor export controls/supply-chain or cross-border demand constraints for MU/NVDA/ANET, and digital-regulatory or cross-border advertising/data risks for META and QQQ look-through. Separate verified dated policy facts from conditional exposure inferences; do not make an investment conclusion. Explicitly state if available sources cannot establish current policy actions, company-specific revenue exposure, or timing. Stop once the bounded sources establish (or fail to establish) material channels.
arguments.decision_impact: Tests whether shared policy/geopolitical shocks could invalidate company-specific and QQQ short-horizon scenarios, without assuming unverified exposure weights.
